decision: Select exact categorical site-MLP input reuse for the next isolated implementation before approximate architecture changes.

exact_reuse_breakdown.note: The internal count is a rigorous bound from total unique upward states and the maximum number of leaf states, not a separately measured exact internal-state count. Most total sharing is leaf/input sharing. Strict source-ID zero reuse was only a conservative lower bound, not evidence that primitive input reuse was absent.

selected_exact_operator.input: Same original observed site allele call/missingness for each haplotype; same per-site donor frequencies, donor masks, panel allele frequencies and entropy; same original256-site chunk and hold membership.
equations: f(s,a) is exactly the existing15D site-MLP input for observed allele/missing category a at site s.
Apply unchanged called masks and original per-hold, per-haplotype chunk sum/max/count pooling, followed by the same span/count/empty projection and role/age injection.
Autograd accumulates all gathered uses: dL/dtheta=sum(s,a) [sum(h with genotype(s,h)=a) dL/de(s,h)] dMLP_theta(f(s,a))/dtheta.
selected_exact_operator.complexity_after: O(S*A*C_MLP + S*H*d), where A is observed allele/missing categories; exact primitive deduplication across sites is optional.
selected_exact_operator.unchanged: All haplotypes, SNPs, native intervals, ancestry readout coordinates, sample identities, early mutation-conditioned lineage messages, model parameters, objective and simulation core.
selected_exact_operator.expression_qualification: Same learned operator and primitive inputs with original pooling reductions; FP32 batch-kernel differences still require output and parameter-gradient tolerance checks. Preserve max-tie and missing-call behavior.
selected_exact_operator.no_two_by_two_scientific_confound: The selected operator retains the current model and early allele interactions. It is an execution qualification, not a late-SNP versus early-SNP architectural intervention.
selected_exact_operator.limits: Pooling/gather remains O(SH*d); internal tree sweeps, second-sweep history and T*H sequence contexts remain. A large reduction in MLP rows is not an end-to-end speedup claim.

low_rank_diagnostic.interpretation: Centered variation is small and spectrally concentrated at this checkpoint, but rare pointwise errors remain substantial. Span-weighted rank8 upward worst relative error is20.23percent. None of these vector errors establishes ancestry or boundary accuracy.
low_rank_diagnostic.algorithm_caveat: Posthoc projection of already-computed32D states to8D only reduces storage/transfer; it does not remove full sweep FLOPs. A cheap coefficient recurrence with validated error bounds would be a separate approximation.

future_hypothesis_only.status: Candidate only; not selected, implemented or trained
future_hypothesis_only.structural_plus_correction: h_v(x)=s_g(v)+B_r*a_v(x), where s is a reusable full-depth structural state and a is a position-dependent correction driven by the current observed SNP/base/gate inputs. Moving all genotype input to a late readout can lose mutation-conditioned lineage reasoning.
future_hypothesis_only.current_message_approximation: For W*h, precompute W*s and W*B_r, giving O(d*r) rather than O(d*d) variation work if coefficients can be propagated cheaply. Gates, nonlinear updates and LayerNorm can create components outside the retained subspace; projecting them changes the operator and needs adaptive error control.
future_hypothesis_only.interval_functional_form: m_e(x)=1_[left_e,right_e)(x) * g_e(x) * W*h_child(x)/degree_parent(x), followed by the same full-depth tree recurrence. Genomic coordinates and persistent sample routes stay explicit.
future_hypothesis_only.support_caution: Projecting interval masks into a global low-rank basis can leak messages outside true edge support. Exact overlap Gram matrices preserve integrated linear forms, not pointwise topology. A credible candidate needs local support-respecting bases or exact final masks and incident-edge endpoint refinement, plus explicit projection/nonlinear error measurement.
future_hypothesis_only.complexity_caution: Cost scales with total local basis/rank support and edge-overlap transforms, not simply global node count. Relate may have many persistent nodes; breakpoint refinement can erase savings. Full-depth topology must be retained or any shallow propagation loss declared.
future_hypothesis_only.boundary_caution: L2/span averages can hide short-tract and transition errors. Adaptive refinement must consider pointwise residuals at observed topology/SNP changes, and future held-out tract/boundary metrics; no truth is used by this diagnostic.
